title: What to do as a family in November | Family Season
description: Three ready plans for November for the whole family: board games in the evenings, theatre and ballet, and a month of Italian cooking. Open one, change it, print it on A4.
label: November
heading: What to do as a family in November
lead: November is the darkest month with nothing to celebrate: too cold to walk, too early for the New Year, and the evenings come one after another all alike.
So everything worth doing happens indoors — at the table, in a hall, in the kitchen. It is the one month you have to invent from beginning to end.
seasonsText: Each one opens in full: the weeks, a project for everybody in the family, the goal of the month. Any of them can be rewritten for you and printed on two A4 sheets.
actionText: If none of them fits, build your own: the theme of the month, four weeks and a project each. It prints the same way — two pages, and onto the fridge.
moreText: Other families put their seasons up too — there are more on the showcase.
